overview_description.description: BlockBase Mining is a blockchain infrastructure and cryptocurrency mining company. The company provides hosted cryptocurrency mining services, mining hardware procurement, and infrastructure support for individuals and institutional clients involved in digital asset mining. Its services include sourcing ASIC mining equipment, setting up mining operations, and managing hosted mining facilities for cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, and Monero.
